title: Harness RSI

domains.name: Coding
domains.subtitle: Executable artifacts, precise edits and verifiable delivery.

findings.title: Keep the edit payload intact.
findings.before: A multiline file-write call is rejected and its code is sent to the shell.
findings.after: Dispatch by editing-command name and preserve the remaining text as the file payload. Related updates normalize editor inputs or return structured experiment results.
findings.result: On an external Go repair task, ModularRSI reports 36 → 25 mean interaction steps across three successful runs per version. SICA and SIA address other edit and experiment interfaces.
findings.limit: Concurrent edits prevent attributing the step reduction to dispatch alone. SICA reports implemented updates; final retention is not confirmed.

sources.name: ModularRSI
sources.locator: Appendix D.4; Listings 7–9; version-specific Go repair case

sources.name: SIA
sources.locator: ML experiment driver and parameter–score interface

findings.title: Read the region, not the whole world.
findings.before: Whole-file views and long tool returns consume the working context.
findings.after: Use line-range reads and unique-string replacement; keep the head and tail of long outputs; shorten older returns. ML agents can retain bounded experiment summaries.
findings.result: The complete Multi-task Self-Harness recovers 7 of 12 SWE-Bench Pro tasks where the seed exceeds the input limit.
findings.limit: This is not a truncation-only ablation. DGM, SICA and AIDE² offer complementary implementations rather than a shared evaluated patch.

sources.name: DGM
sources.locator: Agent tool evolution and editing-tool case analysis

sources.name: AIDE²
sources.locator: Discovered search strategies and bounded experiment summaries

findings.title: Recover from the failure that actually happened.
findings.before: An empty patch, a failed test and a missing dependency all look like an unfinished task.
findings.after: Retry empty patches, send test failures to repair, install missing dependencies before debugging source, and protect already validated outputs.
findings.result: Self-Harness’s paired Astropy case progresses from syntax-only checking to executable verification; all four previously failing FAIL-TO-PASS tests pass.
findings.limit: The Astropy result is a whole-harness comparison. Retry paths and artifact protection come from distinct studies and settings.

sources.locator: Appendix C.1–C.2; shell-guard and completion cases

domains.name: Reasoning & information
domains.subtitle: Interpretations, competing answers and machine-checkable proofs.

findings.title: Check the question before computing the answer.
findings.before: Calculation can proceed from a mistaken interpretation of the problem or source document.
findings.after: Revise a structured problem representation, or specify operands, denominators and corpus checks before calculating. AFlow instead verifies a selected answer computationally.
findings.result: The reusable change is where checking enters the computation: before interpretation is fixed, or after a candidate answer exists.
findings.limit: These observations locate different verification stages; they do not isolate causal performance gains.

sources.name: ADAS
sources.locator: Discovered arithmetic agent and structured problem representation

findings.title: Retrieve the evidence that separates answers.
findings.before: More similar examples need not resolve the distinction between competing labels or answers.
findings.after: Retrieve same-label confirmers and competing-label challengers; mix word- and character-based rankings; activate name-stripped queries and multi-hop decomposition.
findings.result: EvolveMem’s repeated-evolution ablations lose LoCoMo F1 when either query mechanism is removed.
findings.limit: The ablation concerns the evolution procedure, not one fixed checkpoint. A classifier reused across datasets is one artifact, not independent discoveries.

sources.name: Meta-Harness
sources.locator: Draft-verification and selected single-call classifier analyses

sources.name: EvolveMem
sources.locator: LoCoMo ablations of query preprocessing and decomposition

findings.title: Make a failed proof actionable.
findings.before: Whole-file compilation gives limited support for testing and revising a local proof step.
findings.after: Add persistent proof states, rollback and local trials; use bounded Lean repairs and verify lemma names and signatures.
findings.result: A richer Lean helper-lemma branch encounters context and assembly failures. A heavily used Rocq lemma-search proposal is rejected without accuracy gains.
findings.limit: More tools and more decomposition do not reliably yield completed proofs; final status matters as much as tool usage.

sources.locator: Evolved repair and helper-lemma lineage analysis

sources.name: Prover-interface evolution
sources.locator: Persistent state, rollback, local trials and rejected lemma search

domains.name: Interactive & embodied
domains.subtitle: Actions whose consequences change the next state.

findings.title: Bind an action to the right object.
findings.before: A textbox lookup is ambiguous, or an API action is attempted without authentication.
findings.after: Restrict the lookup to its confirmation dialog; supply login guidance and restate prerequisites after repeated authorization errors.
findings.result: SkillWeaver retains an executable selector patch. LiteEvo’s prompt-plus-processor bundle outperforms either component alone in AppWorld.
findings.limit: The bundle result does not isolate the login reminder. Object selection and prerequisites are different repairs to action execution.

findings.title: Turn task rules into executable checks.
findings.before: The agent must track admissible actions and evaluate competing moves during interaction.
findings.after: Synthesize game-specific legality code or reusable probability calculations; use expected value to choose between raising and calling.
findings.result: AutoHarness constrains admissible actions. A selected DemoEvolve Liar’s Dice variant changes when the agent calls rather than raises.
findings.limit: AutoHarness’s outer action/retry loop is supplied architecture. The evolved legality code must not be confused with that inherited loop.

sources.name: DemoEvolve
sources.locator: Liar’s Dice artifact and selected expected-value variant

findings.title: Recover from the observed physical state.
findings.before: Placement can fail because the grasp is unstable or the target geometry is misestimated.
findings.after: Add bounded regrasp, memory of failed geometries and support checks; alternatively correct the basket target from upper-rim points while keeping the controller.
findings.result: Zetta’s cumulative stack transfers unchanged to three related tasks: mean success rises from 64% to 84%.
findings.limit: The result does not isolate individual recovery branches or establish transfer to other domains. HarnessPAI supplies a complementary state-estimation repair.

sources.name: Zetta
sources.locator: Placement lineage and three-task unchanged-stack transfer

domains.name: Visual understanding & generation
domains.subtitle: Grounded observations and reusable composition procedures.

findings.title: Keep claims attached to observations.
findings.before: A text conclusion alone can lose which frame, event or input reference supports it.
findings.after: Store frame-linked findings, uncertainty and entity/event relations; bind requested subjects and scene elements to specific image references.
findings.result: Video-RSI’s full evolved harness moves MLVU accuracy from 62.4% to 72.9% while using fewer frames.
findings.limit: This does not isolate the graph’s contribution or establish lower total compute. AutoRef addresses reference binding in a different task.

findings.title: Recheck the interval with the same frames.
findings.before: One generic prediction from 64 uniform frames can miss repeated events or interval boundaries.
findings.after: Add event-boundary checks, trigger extra predictions conditionally and aggregate endpoints by medians.
findings.result: VideoEvolve improves a kettle case, but a light-switch regression persists despite additional calls.
findings.limit: All configurations use the same frames. Additional reasoning costs compute and can preserve the same mistaken interpretation.

findings.title: Compare drafts against concrete failure conditions.
findings.before: Draft selection can overlook reference-specific failures or depend on presentation order.
findings.after: Generate subject-led and background-led drafts, check hard failures and require a tied challenger to win in both orders. Other work retains composition recipes or production skills.
findings.result: At a fixed three-image budget, AutoRef’s held-out average falls from 7.37 to 6.93 when its combined failure-aware selector is replaced.
findings.limit: The ablation does not isolate order swapping. Reusable selection and composition procedures are the harness artifacts; a generated image is not.

sources.name: AutoRef
sources.locator: Section 6.5; Table 4; Appendices D and H.2

description: From harness optimization to recursive self-improvement: a survey of reusable changes around language model agents.

evidence.unit: A source study within a task subcategory. Records are not independent effects; they include reporting gaps.
evidence.release: All 95 domain records are available in the benchmark explorer and downloadable evidence data. The manuscript is forthcoming.

insights.title: Repair the connection, not just the reasoning.
insights.summary: Some gains come from making an existing intention reach the right tool, object or observation. A higher task score need not mean a new reasoning capability.
insights.question: Where does an intended operation lose its meaning?

cells.label: Command → intact payload
cells.detail: Route a multiline file edit to the editor, not the shell.

cells.label: Question → correct operands
cells.detail: Resolve the problem representation before calculation.

cells.label: Action → intended object
cells.detail: Scope a textbox lookup to its confirmation dialog.

cells.label: Claim → source observation
cells.detail: Keep findings linked to frames or input references.

insights.title: More context and more tools are not enough.
insights.summary: Useful additions resolve a pending decision. Rejected tools and failed branches matter alongside successful changes; these cases do not establish a universal preference for smaller harnesses.
insights.question: What information could change the next decision?

cells.label: Relevant code region
cells.detail: Read locally and bound long tool returns.

cells.label: Competing explanations
cells.detail: Retrieve label challengers, not only similar examples.

cells.label: Legality and value
cells.detail: Compute admissibility and compare action values.

cells.label: Evidence provenance
cells.detail: Query linked observations before acquiring more frames.

insights.title: A retry rule carries conditions for reuse.
insights.summary: Recovery depends on a detectable failure, observable state and an available corrective action. Transfer between related placement tasks is documented; cross-domain analogies remain hypotheses.
insights.question: What must be true for this recovery to work?

cells.label: Empty patch / failed test
cells.detail: Choose retry, repair or environment setup by failure type.

cells.label: A local proof failure
cells.detail: Restore a proof state and test a bounded revision.

cells.label: Grasp and support state
cells.detail: Regrasp or correct target geometry before release.

cells.label: Ambiguous event boundary
cells.detail: Recheck the interval; repeated interpretation can still fail.
